A.name: Window-random
A.description: 3 s windows shuffled at random: windows of one clip sit in train and test.

B.name: Clip-random
B.description: Whole clips at random from all 999, stratified by genre (5 seeds).

Bp.name: Clip-random, fault-filtered
Bp.description: As B, but only from the 929 clips left after removing duplicates, mislabels and distortions (5 seeds).

D.name: Artist-grouped, random
D.description: As B′, but every artist's clips stay in one part (5 seeds).

C.name: Published artist-disjoint
C.description: The published fault-filtered split (Kereliuk, Sturm & Larsen 2015). Main result.
